This is the new Volvo XC60!

It’s the Swedish brand's bread-and-butter family SUV, but with the BMW X3, Mercedes GLC, and Audi Q5 all getting recent updates, can this refreshed Volvo still compete? Let’s take a closer look…

At first glance, you’d be forgiven for thinking not much has changed. Volvo has stuck to the "if it ain't broke" philosophy when it comes to the exterior design. There’s a new grille and some darker tinting on the taillights, but the lights and bumpers remain largely the same. However, you can now spice things up with new paint colours (like Mulberry Red), fresh wheel designs, and optional black exterior trim for a stealthier look. Crucially, there’s no cheap-looking plastic cladding here - it’s premium through and through.
